golangci-lint.integrity: SHA-256 over the official release archive
golangci-lint.network_behavior: bootstrap downloads one exact GitHub release asset; scan may resolve Go modules through the configured Go proxy
golangci-lint.exit_semantics: 0 clean; nonzero finding, configuration, bootstrap, or internal failure blocks
golangci-lint.machine_readable_output: golangci-lint JSON output is supported; the unit runner currently emits bounded text
golangci-lint.sanitized_artifact_policy: paths and diagnostic text only; no environment capture

actionlint.network_behavior: bootstrap downloads one exact GitHub release asset; scan is offline
actionlint.exit_semantics: 0 clean; nonzero finding or tool failure blocks
actionlint.machine_readable_output: JSON Lines through a repository-owned format template
actionlint.blocking_mapping: every finding and every tool failure blocks

zizmor.network_behavior: bootstrap downloads one exact GitHub release asset; scan uses --offline
zizmor.exit_semantics: 0 clean; finding exits are accepted only within the explicit no-regression baseline; tool failures block
zizmor.suppression_mechanism: zizmor workflow comments recorded by suppression visibility
zizmor.blocking_mapping: finding count above baseline or any invalid/internal result blocks

betterleaks.network_behavior: bootstrap downloads one exact GitHub release asset; scan is static and local with validation disabled
betterleaks.exit_semantics: 0 clean; finding or tool failure blocks
betterleaks.suppression_mechanism: repository Betterleaks configuration; suppressions are inventoried
betterleaks.blocking_mapping: every finding and every tool failure blocks
betterleaks.sanitized_artifact_policy: 100 percent matched-value redaction; no validation callbacks

hadolint.network_behavior: bootstrap downloads one exact GitHub release asset; scan is offline
hadolint.exit_semantics: 0 clean; finding exits are accepted only within the explicit no-regression baseline; tool failures block
hadolint.suppression_mechanism: Dockerfile hadolint comments recorded by suppression visibility
hadolint.blocking_mapping: finding count above baseline or any invalid/internal result blocks

uv.network_behavior: bootstrap downloads one exact GitHub release asset; drift checks query explicit PyPI authority through the repository-owned immutable upload cutoff
uv.exit_semantics: 0 generated successfully; every nonzero exit blocks
uv.current_baseline: both tracked requirements locks reproduce byte-for-byte
uv.blocking_mapping: generation failure or byte drift blocks
uv.sanitized_artifact_policy: package names, versions, and distribution hashes only

pip-audit.integrity: uv-generated SHA-256 hashes for every Python distribution
pip-audit.network_behavior: bootstrap uses PyPI; audit queries the PyPI vulnerability service without uploading source
pip-audit.blocking_mapping: new vulnerability or invalid/internal result blocks
pip-audit.sanitized_artifact_policy: package names, versions, and vulnerability IDs only

govulncheck.network_behavior: bootstrap uses the Go proxy/checksum database; audit queries the Go vulnerability database without uploading source
govulncheck.blocking_mapping: every reachable finding and every failure blocks

semgrep.integrity: uv-generated SHA-256 hashes for every Python distribution
semgrep.network_behavior: bootstrap uses PyPI; scan uses repository-owned rules with metrics off and no login
semgrep.exit_semantics: 0 clean; 1 finding under --error; operational failures block
semgrep.suppression_mechanism: nosemgrep directives recorded by suppression visibility
semgrep.blocking_mapping: every finding and every failure blocks
semgrep.sanitized_artifact_policy: relative paths, rule IDs, and bounded diagnostics only

malskanner.network_behavior: bootstrap uses npm; deterministic scan is local and never uses --ai or ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
malskanner.blocking_mapping: RepoMap policy blocks WARN and REFUSE
malskanner.sanitized_artifact_policy: finding metadata only; matched content is omitted from retained evidence
malskanner.version_attestation: npm package and integrity lock are 0.1.3; the upstream 0.1.3 package contains a stale CLI banner reporting 0.1.1

prompt-defense-audit.network_behavior: bootstrap uses npm; scan is local regex with no model or API key
prompt-defense-audit.exit_semantics: 0 completed; RepoMap evaluates structured results against a no-regression baseline
prompt-defense-audit.current_baseline: score and finding-count ratchet over the declared effective bundle
prompt-defense-audit.blocking_mapping: score decrease or finding-count increase blocks; tool failure blocks
prompt-defense-audit.sanitized_artifact_policy: counts and grade only; instruction contents are not retained
prompt-defense-audit.attestation_limit: grade is static prompt coverage, not runtime-resistance proof

liquibase.integrity: SHA-256 over the official release archive
liquibase.network_behavior: bootstrap downloads the exact release; validation uses offline:postgresql without secrets or a database
liquibase.exit_semantics: 0 valid; every validation or operational failure blocks
